title: Anthropic Becomes SpaceX's Largest Customer as Third Quarter Spend Hits $5B

tickers.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
The developer of the Claude AI bot provided roughly 34.5% of the revenue generated by SpaceX during the third quarter, bringing in approximately $5 billion. According to a company filing, the payment makes Anthropic the single largest client for the aerospace venture, overtaking the US government in terms of income contributed during the period.

The revenue is part of a long-term agreement worth up to $120.5 billion through 2029 for the use of Nvidia GPU capacity and computing power. While Anthropic will increase its monthly payments to SpaceX to $3.1 billion starting in December, either party may cancel the contract with 90 days' notice beginning in early 2027. Analyst Brian Sozzi noted that a disappointing first earnings report for Anthropic as a public company could negatively affect SpaceX shares.
